```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Cache Turbo
        uses: rharkor/caching-for-turbo@v2.3.11
        with:
          provider: github
          cache-prefix: turbo
          max-age: 86400
          max-files: 200
          max-size: 500000

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Type check
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build -t arr-dashboard:latest .

      - name: Run Docker container
        run: |
          docker run -d --name arr-dashboard -p 3000:3000 arr-dashboard:latest
          # Wait for the container to be ready
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health | grep -q "ok"; then
              echo "Container is healthy"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for container to start... ($i)"
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          if ! curl -f http://localhost:3000/health; then
            echo "Health check failed"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Health check passed"

      - name: Show container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs arr-dashboard

      - name: Stop and remove container
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker stop arr-dashboard
          docker rm arr-dashboard

      - name: Docker image size
        run: docker images arr-dashboard:latest --format "{{.Size}}"
```
